_comment: Profile taxonomy for make knowledge-classify: deterministic consolidation of overlapping
new-profile proposals into one broad family per run. Nothing here creates a profile; a
canonical family that already exists as a profile is assigned (for review), otherwise one
proposal per family is written to the plan. A proposed name also folds into an existing
profile or a family when it is a dash-separated child of it (psychology-cognitive ->
psychology, red-team-web-apps -> red-team). Override the file with KNOWLEDGE_TAXONOMY=<path>.
parent: the existing profile the family sits under ('none' or omitted when it is top-level);
tags: subtopics every member of the family inherits as plan tags.
